note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely claimed: dated customs/B-L records exist with destination, HS code and BOL number (e.g. BOL 8895104, Ahmedabad ICD -> Jeddah, 2025-03-11). Important caveat on identity: the export row carrying the exact name 'APOLLO TECHNO INDUSTRIES LIMITED' as shipper appears on the APOLLO TECHNO EQUIPMENTS LIMITED page (BOL 8144105, Mumbai Custom House Sea -> Bahrain, 2025-12-23), while the bulk of the outbound records sit under the closely related 'APOLLOTECHNO INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED' at the identical registered address; the group also includes APOLLOTECHNO INTERNATIONAL FZCO (Dubai) as a buyer. Treat the three names as one trading group when assessing shipment reality. HS discrepancy: declared HS 851779 (telecom/electronics parts) does not match any observed record. Actual observed HS codes are 84314390 / 84314310 / 84304900 (drilling and boring machinery and parts), 84122990 / 84129090 (hydraulic motors and parts), 85365090 (joystick switches) and 84122990. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base, the code should be corrected to the factual 8431/8430/8412 range, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'IT и электроника' is likewise inaccurate - the company is a drilling-rig / horizontal-directional-drilling equipment maker and trader. Role: manufacturer_trader (imports components from China, USA, Germany, France, UK and re-exports finished rigs and parts). Revenue and export volume figures: null - not public in the sources reachable; ImportKey shows shipment counts (310 / 319 / 23) but no values, and no financial statements were retrievable. Domestic supply evidence is weak: GSTIN 24AAOCA3279J1ZC is evidenced, but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or contract was found, so domestic_status is declared_only rather than confirmed.
